suitableFor: two-up text/list cards such as Do / Don't guidance
cards that contain a heading, a bulleted list, and a read-more link
image-less card groups on sub-topic detail pages
notSuitableFor: cards that need a top image (use cards-minimal-dark-withimg or cards-minimal-dark-withimg-2)
single side-by-side text + image promos (use columns-minimal-dark)

notes: New variant for the topic-hub-subnav template. Text/list-only cards (no images) -- structurally distinct from the existing image card variants. decorate() flattens each row into a single card body containing the heading, list, and CTA link.
